description: Get facts for a specific managed disk or all managed disks.

parameters.name: ad_user
parameters.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: adfs_authority_url
parameters.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

parameters.name: api_profile
parameters.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of latest is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack. Default: "latest"

parameters.name: auth_source
parameters.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE environment variable. When set to auto (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> env -> credential_file -> cli. When set to env, the credentials will be read from the environment variables When set to credential_file, it will read the profile from ~/.azure/credentials. When set to cli, the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if more than one is present otherwise the default az cli subscription is used. When set to msi, the host machine must be an azure resource with an enabled MSI extension. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if the resource is granted access to more than one subscription, otherwise the first subscription is chosen. The msi was added in Ansible 2.6. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "cli" "credential_file" "env" "msi"

parameters.name: cert_validation_mode
parameters.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing ignore. Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION environment variable. Choices: "ignore" "validate"

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

parameters.name: cloud_environment
parameters.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, AzureChinaCloud, AzureUSGovernment), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT environment variable. Default: "AzureCloud"

parameters.name: disable_instance_discovery
parameters.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validation of the authority is disabled. As a result, it is crucial to ensure that the configured authority host is valid and trustworthy. Set via credential file profile or the AZURE_DISABLE_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: log_mode
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: managed_by
parameters.description: Limit results to disks managed by the given VM fqid.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Limit results to a specific managed disk.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

parameters.name: resource_group
parameters.description: Limit results to a specific resource group. Required if name is set

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Limit results by providing a list of tags. Format tags as ‘key’ or ‘key:value’.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: thumbprint
parameters.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in x509_certificate_path. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if x509_certificate_path is defined.

parameters.name: x509_certificate_path
parameters.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

examples:
- name: Get facts for one managed disk
  azure_rm_manageddisk_info:
    name: Testing
    resource_group: myResourceGroup

- name: Get facts for all managed disks
  azure_rm_manageddisk_info:

- name: Get facts for all managed disks managed by a specific vm
  azure_rm_manageddisk_info:
    managed_by: '/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroups/rgName/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/vmName'

- name: Get facts by tags
  azure_rm_manageddisk_info:
    tags:
      - testing

return_values.name: azure_managed_disk
return_values.description: List of managed disk dicts. Returned: always

return_values.name: create_option
return_values.description: Create option of the disk. Returned: success Sample: "copy"

return_values.name: disk_access_id
return_values.description: ARM ID of the DiskAccess resource for using private endpoints on disks. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/*********/resourceGroups/myRG/providers/Microsoft.Compute/diskAccesses/diskacc"

return_values.name: disk_iops_read_only
return_values.description: The total throughput (MBps) that will be allowed across all VMs mounting the shared disk as ReadOnly. One operation can transfer between 4k and 256k bytes. Returned: always Sample: 200

return_values.name: disk_iops_read_write
return_values.description: The number of IOPS allowed for this disk. Only settable for storage_account_type=UltraSSD_LRS disks. One operation can transfer between 4k and 256k bytes. Returned: always Sample: 200

return_values.name: disk_m_bps_read_only
return_values.description: The total throughput (MBps) that will be allowed across all VMs mounting the shared disk as ReadOnly. MBps means millions of bytes per second - MB here uses the ISO notation, of powers of 10. Returned: always Sample: 30

return_values.name: disk_m_bps_read_write
return_values.description: The bandwidth allowed for this disk. Only settable for storage_account_type=UltraSSD_LRS disks. One operation can transfer between 4k and 256k bytes. Returned: always Sample: 30

return_values.name: disk_size_gb
return_values.description: Size in GB of the managed disk to be created. Returned: success

return_values.name: gallery_image_reference
return_values.description: The Gallery Image info. Returned: always Sample: "None"

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: Resource id. Returned: success

return_values.name: image_reference
return_values.description: Disk source information for PIR or user images or Gallery Image. Returned: always Sample: "None"

return_values.name: last_ownership_update_time
return_values.description: The UTC time when the ownership state of the disk was last changed. The time the disk was last attached or detached from a VM or the time when the VM to which the disk was attached was deallocated or started. Returned: always Sample: "2025-06-27T01:55:10.239311+00:00"

return_values.name: location
return_values.description: Valid Azure location. Returned: success

return_values.name: logical_sector_size
return_values.description: Logical sector size in bytes for Ultra disks. Returned: always Sample: "None"

return_values.name: managed_by
return_values.description: Name of an existing virtual machine with which the disk is or will be associated, this VM should be in the same resource group. Returned: success Sample: "/subscriptions/xxx-xxx/resourceGroups/myRG/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/testVM"

return_values.name: managed_by_extended
return_values.description: List ID of an existing virtual machine with which the disk is or will be associated. Returned: success Sample: ["/subscriptions/xxx-xxx/resourceGroups/myRG/providers/Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/testVM"]

return_values.name: max_shares
return_values.description: The maximum number of VMs that can attach to the disk at the same time. Value greater than one indicates a disk that can be mounted on multiple VMs at the same time. Returned: success Sample: 3

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the managed disk. Returned: success

return_values.name: network_access_policy
return_values.description: Policy for accessing the disk via network. Returned: always Sample: "AllowAll"

return_values.name: os_type
return_values.description: Type of Operating System. Returned: success Can only return: "linux" "windows"

return_values.name: performance_plus
return_values.description: The flag of the performance target of the disk deployed. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: public_network_access
return_values.description: Policy for controlling export on the disk. Returned: always Sample: "Enabled"

return_values.name: security_profile
return_values.description: The security related information for the resource. Returned: success

return_values.name: secure_vm_disk_encryption_set_id
return_values.description: ResourceId of the disk encryption set associated to Confidential VM supported disk encrypted with customer managed key. Returned: when-used Sample: "None"

return_values.name: security_type
return_values.description: Specifies the SecurityType of the VM. Returned: when-used Sample: "TrustedLaunch"

return_values.name: source_resource_id
return_values.description: This is the ARM id of the source snapshot or disk. Returned: always Sample: "None"

return_values.name: source_uri
return_values.description: URI to a valid VHD file to be used or the resource ID of the managed disk to copy. Returned: success

return_values.name: storage_account_type
return_values.description: Type of storage for the managed disk. See https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-machines/windows/disks-types for more information about this type. Returned: success Sample: "Standard_LRS"

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: Tags to assign to the managed disk. Returned: success Sample: {"tag": "value"}

return_values.name: tier
return_values.description: Performance tier assigned to the managed disk. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-machines/disks-change-performance for more information about disk performance tiers. Returned: success Sample: "P30"

return_values.name: time_created
return_values.description: The time the disk was created. Returned: success Sample: "2018-01-01T11:08:15.338648900:00"

return_values.name: upload_size_bytes
return_values.description: This is the size of the contents of the upload including the VHD footer. Returned: always Sample: "None"
